messages:
sam: Quick sync 1 postmortem follow-ups from last night's cross-region LB/TLS retry surge. Need concrete owners and dates. Root cause looks like TLS handshake tail latencies triggering fast client retries + conntrack exhaustion.

maria: I'll take routing debounce and prefix caching audit. Plan: add 200ms debounce on the route-change handler and emit metrics. Target: EOD Wed (2026-03-25).

alex: I'll own conntrack emergency fix + capacity testing. Immediate hotfix: bump conntrack hashsize+gc threshold. Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 50% -> 100% today. Full benchmark with k6 on Thu.

raj: I'll own cert/fallback logic. Goal: fallback to TLS1.2 for specific cipher negotiation errors instead of aborting. Canary and cert rotation test tomorrow.

jen: I'll coordinate rollouts and document rollback knobs. Also adding an ops alert for TLS handshake error rate > 0.5% and conntrack table occupancy > 85%. Target rollout Fri morning.

ops_oncall: Logs during spike (excerpts):
```
[2026-03-22T23:41:02Z] LB: tls: handshake timeout client=10.12.4.7
[2026-03-22T23:41:02Z] conntrack: insert failed: table full, conn=98765
[2026-03-22T23:41:03Z] route: route-change flood service=web-edge region=eu-west-1
```
Many short flows observed; client retry backoff truncated to <100ms in some SDKs.

sam: ops, can you add packet-capture playbook? Also @deploy-bot tag the affected node group for correlation.

ops_oncall: Playbook: https://confluence.redwood/incident/playbooks/pcap-capture
Tagged node group: lb-eu-west-1-prod-rotary

deploy-bot: Conntrack hotfix PR detected, CI green. Deploy started by jen. ETA ~ 28m. :rocket:

maria: Metrics I'll add: `route.debounce.count`, `route.debounce.latency_ms`, and `route.change.rate`. Will create dashboard and an eval shard to ensure no streaming latency regressions.

alex: Hotfix checklist:
1) bump conntrack hashsize
2) increase gc trigger threshold
3) canary 5% -> 50% -> 100% with pre/post metrics
4) run k6 long-tail profile and post numbers
PR + checklist coming.

raj: Cert fallback plan details: compatibility matrix, explicit mapping of cipher errors -> fallback path, and alert when fallback rate > 0.1%. Reaching out to CDN partner for cipher mismatch logs.

jen: Consolidated tracker (I'll maintain):
- Routing debounce (owner: maria) - due 2026-03-25
- Conntrack hotfix (owner: alex) - due 2026-03-23 (hotfix)
- Conntrack capacity test (owner: alex) - due 2026-03-26
- Cert fallback + canary (owner: raj) - due 2026-03-24
- Rollout coordination + alerting (owner: jen) - due 2026-03-27

sam: Add automation: ops, can we add a scheduled query to detect cross-region retry spikes by origin/destination within 10m windows and post weekly digests to infra leads?

ops_oncall: Added scheduled query `cross_region.retry_spike` every 15m, digest posted to #incidents-weekly. Also annotated the postmortem with the metric thresholds.

maria: I'll add a small smoke that calls randomized prefixes during the debounce rollout to ensure route-change rate stays below threshold. PR soon.

alex: Will run k6 profile after hotfix and upload artifact link here.

raj: Will open PR for cert fallback and paste link when ready. Also emailing CDN partner for logs.

sam: Thanks all. Jen share the issue tracker link and ping me if anyone misses dates. We'll review in Monday retro.

jen: Tracker: https://go.redwood/issue/INC-4521

sam: Closing thread unless post-rollout regressions appear. :white_check_mark:
